information: Co-led VETO, a method for protecting user images against unauthorized editing by DiT / rectified-flow models.
Proposed Obliviate, a concept-erasure method for autoregressive image generation models (ECCV 2026).
Contributed to ToBAC, the first multimodal backdoor attack on unified autoregressive models.
Explored learning and personalizing relational concepts in text-to-image diffusion models.
Developed methods for low-light image enhancement (CDAN) and cloud removal from satellite imagery.
Published CDAN in Digital Signal Processing.
Developed a dual-branch network for diabetic retinopathy detection and stage grading.
Published in Biomedical Signal Processing and Control.
Worked across the Software and AI teams on computer-vision tooling for model training and deployment.
Built dataset prep, augmentation, tiling, health-check, backend APIs, etc. (Python, PyTorch, Django).
